...Even hearing that, I'm worried.
I decide to head straight for the small island I was told about.

It's fine. They're just students. Having spent all this time
alongside Sirius Symboli, handling something like this should be—!

...It was what made Sirius Symboli who she is today.
There was no way I wouldn't be drawn to that brilliance.
...I'll make you learn the hard way.
Wh-What's your problem...?

(Guess that was a decent swim.
Still got energy to burn, but I should head b—)

I watched her leave the other Umamusume behind
and go swimming all by herself, but...

The final day of summer training camp. Training was scheduled until the evening,
but where did Sirius Symboli run off to?
I won't hold my breath, but I won't deny it either.
—Only one will stand victorious.

Wh... What's the deal...? Are you gonna tell us
your name instead? I mean, that works too... We'll cheer for you! ...Haha.

The sheer will to radiate an overwhelming light of her own,
and the unyielding strength to stand fearlessly above all others.
Hah. Just wishful thinking? You've really learned to talk big, haven't you?

It's close enough to cross by rowboat or small craft,
and there seem to be tourists around too, so no need to worry, right?

The students recoil at the aura radiating from Sirius Symboli.
Her piercing, intimidating glare is just like that of a wolf.
...Simple enough, isn't it?

Huh?! We're not hitting on you!
We just said we'd root for you, that's all!

(...What a pain in the neck this turned into.
...Hm?)

Sirius Symboli makes no effort to pacify them.
Like a solitary monarch commanding total submission, she speaks.
And at the same time, I make my resolve.

Is she referring to our conversation earlier? Normally, the answer would be the Sun, right?
Yet right now... I can't bring myself to believe that's the answer.
Hmph. Well, aren't I flattered.

...You'd best watch yourself.
Lest you get reduced to ash standing beside me.

Even with an Umamusume's athletic prowess,
swimming that far alone is dangerous. Worried, I went searching for her—
That there is a star right here that scorches everything in its wake—

Still, I have to protect my students.
Steeling myself to try once more, I fix my gaze on them—

...If you got the message, get lost.
Before you lose your way back across the water in the dark.

I told you to stop following us!
You creeps are annoying! We don't have time to deal with you!

I'd praise your spirit, but barking at summer pests is a waste of breath.
...Wouldn't you agree?
Looks like the pup has finally learned how to bare its teeth.

Hah?! That's our line!!
Are you their guardian?! Make these rude brats apologize!

Then let me enlighten you.
Search for the brightest star. Your answer lies right there.
...I bit through that leash a long time ago.

Sirius-senpai~! These guys are seriously relentless!
They keep saying they'll root for us if we're strong Umamusume!
Not a single soul was left to utter a word.

One day, I'll make them realize.
Just how foolish it is to be kept on a leash by meaningless shackles.

—Absolute charisma.
A dazzling, searing light right before my eyes.
Only me.

No one else gets to stand ahead of me.
...Understood?

I intended to deliver a sharp, cutting remark like Sirius Symboli,
but what came out was embarrassingly pathetic.
What is the brightest star?

W-We just...
wanted to know your names so we could root for you...
Her voice, low yet coolly commanding, brings total silence to the scene.
Shut up. I'm in no mood for background noise.

Right after arriving at the islet, I stumbled upon some students
arguing with our Umamusume. I have to break this up immediately.

Sirius-san? Well, I overheard the girls she left behind saying
that she swam all the way out to that islet over there...

Now only Sirius Symboli and I remain on the islet.
Amidst the gentle roar of the waves—
Phew...
